Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks for a productive session this morning — quick recap and action items below. I’ve embedded the highlights and commitments; I’ll follow up with the recording link and final prompt pack later today.

Session highlights:
- Walkthrough of Redwood API and model routing (Marissa) — covered latency vs cost policies and KV caching behavior.
- Prompt review (Karthik) — consolidated prompt set; removed a handful of PII-sensitive examples.
- Hands-on load checks (Dev) — ran two routing variants with 500 concurrent connections in the lab, observed token throughput and a single transient spike that triggered auto-fallback as expected.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Finalize prompt pack (Karthik) — export as prompt-set-final.pdf and push to Drive (due 2026-11-17)
2) Expand load-test thresholds & add trace markers (Dev) — update load-test-plan.md (due 2026-11-18)
3) Routing matrix doc: include regional failover example (Marissa) — update routing-matrix.xlsx (due 2026-11-19)
4) Security follow-up: Dan to confirm PKI questions and any logging retention constraints (Dan/BlueWave) — reply in thread (due 2026-11-20)
5) Schedule deep-dive for performance tuning (60m) — propose Wed 2026-11-24 or Mon 2026-11-29 (Karthik to confirm availability)

Next steps: I propose we meet for a 60-minute performance-deep-dive the week of Nov 23. Option A: Wed 11/24 09:00–10:00 PT, Option B: Mon 11/29 11:00–12:00 PT. Please confirm which option works and whether Dan wants to join.

Related links / artifacts I’ll post after the thread: session recording, Drive folder with prompt-set-final and a trace snapshot.

Thanks again — appreciate the collaboration.
